**Summary (3 bullets)**  
- A fault at Printful’s Latvia facility caused orders from 10–14 Nov to ship 4‑6 days late.  
- Printful will automatically refund the shipping cost on any affected order.  
- The delay is an apology‐style notice; no further action is requested from customers.

**Should you email your customers?**  
Yes.  
- Even though Printful is handling refunds, letting your customers know proactively builds trust.  
- Keep the message short: acknowledge the delay, explain the cause, confirm the refund, and offer a small goodwill gesture if your policy permits.  
- Use the same tone the official note used (polite, apologetic).
